dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Fruits from every corner of Teyvat, including rare Northland varieties you won't find anywhere else! Come try some!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: These are...

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Hehe, nothing but the freshest of ingredients, imported from every corner of Teyvat! Take this plump Zaytun Peach for example, and this Natlanese Quenepa Berry. You won't find these anywhere else in Nod-Krai!

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Well? Feeling hungry just looking at this vibrant spread?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: That is correct! As the saying goes, "No market too far, no business too small"! And since there's a market here, of course I'd like a slice of the pie.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Besides, traveling around and getting to know the local customs of different places is always helpful for doing business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you import these ingredients over?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Wow, wow! A bit brazen to just ask me about my trade secrets, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm just kidding. It all comes down to trustworthy caravans and... special preservation methods. But as for the nitty-gritty? Well, those would be my trade secrets to keep.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Anyways, it's worth the effort to let the people here taste food from overseas, or even from their hometowns, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Bye bye, and take care! If you're ever hungry for new tastes, remember to come back any time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special fruit?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Special fruit? Take a peek at this Zaytun Peach and a gander at this Quenepa Berry. Here in Nod-Krai, these are pretty darn special.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: If you're looking for something from Liyue, I can help you order it in — but you'll be waiting on the caravans to bring it over.

choices.text: That sounds like a bit of a pain...

response.speaker: Cairuo
response.text: No worries, swivel your eyes over this way! These Zaytun Peaches are as fresh as if they just fell from the tree. Here, try one for yourself.

choices.text: I'll see what else you've got.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your goods...

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Everything here's as fresh as fresh can be. Don't worry, take your pick!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Any special fruit in stock today?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: ...I'll have to take a look. What kind of fr{RUBY#[D]intelligence}uit were you hoping to ea{RUBY#[S]purchase}t, Lady Nefer?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh, can your suppliers get you anything I'd like?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Just say the word, and I'll check with the lea{RUBY#[S]Director}der of the caravan.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'm looking to purchase a rather large quantity of fr{RUBY#[D]intelligence}uit, so if possible, I'd very much like to meet this lea{RUBY#[D]Director}der in person.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Ah, well, that would be a decision for the lea{RUBY#[S]Director}der to make. You know our way of doing things, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'm more than happy to wait, if you wouldn't mind passing on my invitation, Miss Cairuo.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Any special fruit in stock today?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Miss Jahoda...? This is surprising. Lady Nefer usually comes to make purchases herself, doesn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm not here to buy fru{RUBY#[D]intel}it today. I'm just looking around. Boss Nefer hasn't given me any spen{RUBY#[S]approval for purchases}ding money.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Oh, is that so? Please feel free to look around then, Miss Jahoda. Let me know if there's anything that interests you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That looks delish.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Hehe, it does, doesn't it? Here, try some! And if you like 'em, feel free to come back any time!
